coverage.scope: All active entries, every skill-tree graph node/edge, and every selectable modifier name from all eight current class SkillKits. Extra localized modifier labels are separated from current nodes.
notes: Blizzard removed standalone Passive and Key Passive nodes from the class skill trees in 3.0; this is intentional, not omitted extraction.
Warlock's SkillKit has 28 active entries but 24 tree unlocks: the extra four entries belong to its Greater Demon class mechanic.
Historical pre-3.0 passive trees are not falsely presented as current. Class mechanics and Paragon are additional catalogue sections.

paragon.scope: All 80 available class boards and every occupied grid cell; all 566 non-placeholder ParagonNode definitions and 161 non-placeholder glyph definitions. Unreferenced definitions are retained and labelled. Magic/normal stat nodes without custom localized names are explicitly unnamed; class-eligibility flags are preserved without inventing an enum mapping.

coverage.scope: Every row from all pages of the public skillbook and Paragon data, all ten classes' two primaries and thirteen equipped skills, twenty ultimates, and named transformation/pet subskills from official introductions.
unresolved: The community database does not expose a game-build identifier; enumeration is complete for this retrieved snapshot, not an executable-level proof of every currently obtainable essence.
Wowhead's unfiltered page stops at 1,000 entries and lacks Druid/Warlock. It is used only to cross-check the first eight classes and add their named ultimates, not as an exhaustive variant source.
Some Tempest unlock levels differ between its older official introduction and the datamined index; required_level remains source-version information, not a current progression guarantee.
notes: Base skillbook has 158 rows: 150 primary/equipped skills, Mist-Touched, Soulgorger, and six transformed Druid skills.
Source descriptions, artwork and numerical balance text are not redistributed.

remaining: An official or lawful current-build Immortal data export is needed to prove live-build equivalence of the community essence/Paragon snapshot.

Historical pre-3.0 Diablo IV passive trees, all prior balance revisions, global item affixes and follower/monster-only powers are outside this current class-ability catalogue; their omission must not be described as all historical game content.
